content:
Priya: Heads up — need to ship a microhotfix during today's freeze gate (slice 22:00 UTC). Small routing fix that prevents a fallback loop for a new model variant. CR1234. Requesting approval and a rollback owner.
Alex: Is this eligible during freeze? Need 2 approvers + canary?
Priya: Ops said yes if we run a canary and keep the window short. This is P1-ish: ~0.2% of requests are misrouted currently.
Oliver: I can own canary + rollback. Plan: deploy canary -> 10m warm -> check metrics -> escalate or promote.
deploy-bot: Canary job started: id=canary-171801, slice=eu-west-1, image=inference-rt:2.14-hotfix
Maria: QA smoke already ran on staging earlier, no regressions.
Alex: What are the exact thresholds we watch?
Priya: Watch p95/p99 latency, 5xx rate, success%, and token cost. Abort if p99 > 250ms or 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 3m. Also watch model token delta metric.
Oliver: I'll pin a fallback route in case we need instant rollback. Pin plan: set pin to v=2026.03.1 and then unpin after stability.
Oliver: Pin command I'll run if we need a rapid revert:
```
./deployctl pin --service inference --version 2026.03.1 --reason "emergency rollback for CR1234"
```
deploy-bot: Canary progress: 2/5 pods healthy, ramp to 20% traffic in 5m
sre-bot: Muting non-critical CPU alerts for this canary window (reason: hotfix canary)
Priya: If canary stable at 15m mark -> promote. If regression -> manual unpin + redeploy previous. Please keep manual rollback instructions visible.
Maria: I'll add a single-line release note: "routing fix: avoid new-model fallback loops (CR1234)" and update changelog.
Alex: I'll record the freeze-exception in the tracker and add approvers. @Priya remember exec approval note.
Priya: Exec note added + Eng Lead approval captured.
Oliver: Promoting canary to 20% now, monitoring p99 and 5xx closely.
deploy-bot: Canary steady at 20% for 15m. No metric breaches observed.
Maria: LGTM on release note, tagging the change with safe-rollout.
Oliver: Starting full promotion (gradual) — abort condition: p99 > 300ms or 5xx pop. Manual abort: run the pin command above then redeploy stable.
deploy-bot: Promotion running -> moving to 100% traffic. If abort required run: ./deployctl pin --service inference --version 2026.03.1
Priya: All green on observability dashboards, closing the hotfix window. Please drop a short note in #postmortems within 24h with lessons and metrics.
Oliver: Will watch for +1h, will file the quick postmortem. Thanks everyone for the quick approvals.
